rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for something strange or not known to you.

example.english: After changing jobs, I’m still unfamiliar with the new environment.
example.traditional: 轉工之後，我對新環境仲唔熟悉。
example.jyutping: zyun3 gung1 zi1 hau6 ngo5 deoi3 san1 waan4 ging2 zung6 m4 suk6 sik1

rows.note: Use this colloquial form especially when you are not familiar with a person, place, or subject.

example.english: I’m unfamiliar with this area, so please show me the way.
example.traditional: 我對呢一帶唔熟，唔該你帶路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 ni1 jat1 daai3 m4 suk6 m4 goi1 nei5 daai3 lou6

rows.note: Use this when describing the feeling or quality of being unfamiliar, especially in more formal or written contexts.

example.english: When I first arrived in a foreign land, everything around me felt unfamiliar.
example.traditional: 初到異鄉，周遭景物都顯得陌生。
example.jyutping: co1 dou3 ji6 hoeng1 zau1 zou1 ging2 mat6 dou1 hin2 dak1 mak6 sang1
